analysis: descriptive only; one G=4 group per task is a noisy estimate (mixed tasks replicated 15/21 in group-informativeness v1)

candidate_rules.run_time_gates: file check (bug applies, file <= max_file_chars, reference blocks restore the file); calibration (baseline fails F2P and passes P2P; reference passes); prompt <= base max_prompt_tokens. Gated-out candidates get no rollouts and are reported by reason.
candidate_rules.tier_A: admitted v1 Train tasks with no base estimate yet, ordered by order_key
candidate_rules.tier_B: SWE-smith-py rows from the five v1 Train repositories, not in either v1 manifest; v1 static filters; dedup by normalized patch hash and (repo, file, issue-text hash) against both v1 manifests and earlier candidates; instance id not mentioned anywhere in the tracked VARE tree; round-robin over repositories in order_key order

classification.rule: k trusted passes of G=4: k=0 all_zero, k=4 all_one, 1<=k<=3 mixed (p_hat in [0.25, 0.75], within [0.1, 0.9])
classification.secondary: pooled with group-informativeness v1 base samples where available, mixed iff 0.1 <= p_hat <= 0.9; reported, not used for the goal

goal.counting: existing base G=4 first estimates (run-001 rollouts, smoke-001 survey) plus this probe

label: exploratory / diagnostic; Train tasks only; no held-out data; no capability claim
question: How many Train tasks have a mixed base-policy outcome (1-3 of G=4 trusted passes at T=0.7)?

stop_rules.action: checked before each candidate; stop and record the reason

verifier: trusted_full_v1 via scoring.score_candidate; reward = 1 iff trusted pass
